summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Perusahaan Perseroan (Persero) PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk, an Indonesian state-owned telecom issuer, providing notice of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders (AGM) for the financial year 2025. The meeting is scheduled for June 8, 2026, to be held electronically via Indonesia's e-GMS system (eASY.KSEI). The agendas are routine: approval of annual report and financial statements, determination of net profit utilization, and setting management remuneration. There are no special-situation elements—no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management changes beyond standard annual approvals. This filing is an ordinary AGM notice, not a special situation.
